name: codex-music-tool
description: Compressed song-recipe descriptor engine over a 1119-tradition / 490-instrument music codex. Generates structural production blueprints, blends traditions, matches axis profiles, and ships a lazy-loading browseable HTML catalog app over a static, server-free JSON API.
author: CodexMusica

scripts.build:api: node scripts/build_static_api.js && node scripts/build_discovery.js && node scripts/check_api.js
scripts.test: npm run test:recipes && npm run test:prefaces && npm run test:slots && npm run test:app && npm run test:equiv && npm run test:lazy && npm run test:connector && npm run eval
scripts.test:connector: node scripts/_gen_voice_parts.js --check && node scripts/check_connector_parity.js && node scripts/check_workspace_ops.js && node scripts/check_app_parity.js && node mcp/test.mjs
scripts.check-docs: node scripts/check_docs.js && node scripts/check_doc_commands.js && node scripts/check_doc_behaviors.js
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build
